title: Do Golden Retrievers Smile?
content: Do golden retrievers smile when they're happy?-There's a big debate on that one.View this post on InstagramSome say they're showing submission, or they just happen to lift up the corners of their mouths when panting, and we're just interpreting it as a human-like expression of joy.Others say that yes, absolutely, goldens truly do smile. Certain breeds have closely co-evolved their behaviors in tandem with those of humans.. We feel the same emotions and mirror each other as we express those feelings.What do you think? Please leave your thoughts in the comments.
